agent_assessment.summary: Investigation into Case ID HHG-007 (Transaction ID: 3514948, Amount: $111.92, Customer ID: C09933) reveals overwhelming evidence of ongoing fraud and account compromise. Although the transaction amount is modest and aligns with the customer's average transaction size, the ML risk score is critically high at 0.87. Regional checks confirm that billing region 264 has never been seen before in the customer's history. Furthermore, historical case analysis shows that customer C09933 has a 95% historical fraud rate across 19 previous cases involving account takeover and out-of-region use. Immediate escalation and account blocking are required.
